summary: You can see when you run a pre-release version, and new sign-in protections are ready to switch on.

fixes.title: Header shows pre-release versions
fixes.text: While your installation runs an early version, the header shows Ring N - Pre-release with its name.

fixes.title: Display names can read PIM Manager
fixes.text: Once that option is on, the update renames the display names people read to "PIM Manager". New installations can choose short resource names.

fixes.title: Stronger protection for app permissions
fixes.text: Setup now checks the web app's permissions in a stronger way.

fixes.title: Sign-in without stored secrets prepared
fixes.text: PIM Manager can sign in through a shared sign-in front without a stored secret, and changes can carry the signed-in user's proof. Both are off by default.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: Closer status reporting to Invardia after an engine update, and corrected test checks.
